items.title: Which Game Outsold GTA 5? 🤔

Tetris claims over 520 million, but that number adds up every Tetris game since 1984. Counted as one single game, the best-seller is Minecraft: Xbox's CEO says over 425 million copies, over 190 million more than GTA 5. Each company counts its own way.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Can it ever catch Minecraft?

items.title: GTA 5 Still Hides These 3 Secrets 👻
items.description:
Thirteen years later, GTA 5 still hides things you can go and find yourself in story mode.

1. In the very first mission in North Yankton, an alien is frozen under the ice by the train bridge. Shooting the ice does nothing.
2. Ride the cable car to the top of Mount Chiliad, GTA 5's highest mountain. Inside the station is a mural: a glowing eye, connected boxes, and what looks like a UFO, an egg and maybe a jetpack. Fans argued about what it means for over a decade.
3. Climb Mount Gordo at 11 PM game time. A ghost appears on the rock, and the name Jock is written in blood. Jock is her husband's name. She is gone at midnight.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Will it have a ghost?

The drawings in this Short are our own, made from the press descriptions below.

Sources:
- Game Informer, How To Find The Ghost In Grand Theft Auto V (Sept 25, 2013): https://www.gameinformer.com/b/features/archive/2013/09/25/how-to-find-the-ghost-in-grand-theft-auto-v.aspx

items.title: GTA 6 Unlocks 18 Hours Early Here 🌏
items.description:
On PlayStation, GTA 6 unlocks at each store's own midnight on November 19, 2026. So it starts in New Zealand.

PlayStation Store unlock times, in New York time (EST):
- New Zealand: midnight NZDT = 6 AM, Wednesday Nov 18
- Sydney: 2 hours later. Tokyo: 2 hours after that.
- UK: midnight GMT = 7 PM, Wednesday Nov 18
- US store: midnight Eastern = 12 AM, Thursday Nov 19

The US PlayStation Store lists one time for the whole country, midnight Eastern. That makes it 9 PM Wednesday in Los Angeles, 10 PM Mountain and 11 PM Central. New York waits 18 hours after New Zealand.

Xbox players: Rockstar and Xbox have not published a store-by-store time we could check, so look at your Xbox store listing.

items.title: GTA 5 Sold a Copy Every 1.8 Seconds 🤯
items.description:
GTA 5 has sold nearly 235 million copies since it launched on September 17, 2013. That is Take-Two's own count from November 2026, and Take-Two counts units sold-in: copies shipped to stores, plus digital downloads.

Spread over the 4,801 days from launch to Take-Two's November 9, 2026 report, that works out to one copy about every 1.8 seconds, or about 48,000 copies on an average day. That is more than the 46,537 seats at Yankee Stadium, every day, for 13 years.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Can it keep that pace up for 13 years?

items.title: The First GTA Was Almost Canceled 🚓
items.description:
Before GTA 6, there was a GTA that almost never happened.

The first Grand Theft Auto began at DMA Design in 1995 as Race'n'Chase, a cops-and-robbers driving game. Development went badly. DMA's Gary Penn said the publisher, BMG Interactive, wanted to can it, the game crashed all the time and the car handling was appalling.

Then, in Penn's words: "One day, I think it was a bug, the police suddenly became mental and aggressive." The cops tried to ram you off the road. "That was awesome, so that stayed in."

GTA came out in 1997. GTA 6 arrives November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Would GTA be the same without psycho cops? Yes or no?

Sources (all read November 11, 2026):
- Gary Penn interview by Tristan Donovan, Gamasutra, January 31, 2011: https://www.gamedeveloper.com/pc/penn-first-i-grand-theft-auto-i-was-almost-canned-
- PC Gamer, February 1, 2011 (same quotes): https://www.pcgamer.com/the-original-grand-theft-auto-was-almost-axed-saved-by-psycho-police-car-bug/
- Race'n'Chase design document from 1995, posted by Mike Dailly (Engadget, March 22, 2011): https://www.engadget.com/2011/03/22/race-n-chase-original-gta-design-docs-posted/

items.title: What Did GTA 5 Really Cost? 💰
items.description:
How much did GTA 5 cost to make? In 2013 The Scotsman reported about 170 million pounds, roughly 265 million dollars, for making and marketing it together. Guinness World Records listed it as the largest videogame budget in 2013. That is a press report, not a number Rockstar or Take-Two published.

Then it launched. Take-Two says GTA 5 passed 1 billion dollars in retail sales in its first three days, almost four times the reported cost, faster than any entertainment release before it.

As of November 17, 2026, Take-Two hasn't given a number for GTA 6's budget. GTA 6: November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Did GTA 6 cost over a billion? Yes or no?

items.title: GTA 3 Didn't Invent Open Worlds 🤔
items.description:
GTA 3 didn't invent open worlds. The first Grand Theft Auto came out in 1997, and you saw its city from straight above. In 2001, GTA 3 took the series into 3D: Rockstar calls it the first three-dimensional, open-world Grand Theft Auto title.

But it wasn't the first 3D open world. The Strong museum, which runs the World Video Game Hall of Fame (GTA 3 was inducted in 2016), says it wasn't the first 3-D sandbox game. Its real first: it was the first of its kind to achieve massive mainstream popularity, and it became a model for many other open-world games that followed.

Twenty-five years later comes GTA 6, dated November 19, 2026. Which was the bigger leap?

Sources:
- Rockstar Games press release, GTA III 10th anniversary, Oct 13 2011: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20111013005654/en/Rockstar-Games-Announces-10th-Anniversary-of-Grand-Theft-Auto-III

items.title: Is GTA 5's City Real? Rockstar's Art Director Answers
items.description:
Is GTA 5's Los Santos a real place? Rockstar sets GTA 5 in a re-imagined, present day Southern California, and Rockstar North's art director says the world incorporates all of Los Angeles. His team shot over 250,000 images for it.

The Hollywood sign became the Vinewood sign. Santa Monica's pier became Del Perro Pier. Even the name plays on it: Santos means saints, Los Angeles means the angels.

But it is not a copy: Rockstar's art director calls the real city a starting point.

Vinewood sign or Del Perro Pier? Which would you visit first?

items.title: How Long Is GTA 5's Story? ⏱️
items.description:
How long is GTA 5's story? Players average 32 hours for the main story on HowLongToBeat, from thousands of submitted play times. Going for 100% takes almost 90 hours (89 and a half), nearly three times as long.

Why the gap? The story missions are only 55% of the game's 100% checklist; the rest is Strangers and Freaks, hobbies and pastimes, random events and miscellaneous extras like collectibles.

As of Nov 17, 2026, Rockstar hasn't said how long GTA 6 is. So for GTA 6: story first, or 100 percent?

Sources:
- HowLongToBeat, Grand Theft Auto V (players' averages, checked Nov 16, 2026): https://howlongtobeat.com/game/4064
- GTABase, GTA 5 100% completion guide (checklist weights: story missions 55%, Strangers and Freaks 10%, Hobbies and Pastimes 10%, Random Events 5%, Miscellaneous 20%; checked Nov 17, 2026): https://www.gtabase.com/grand-theft-auto-v/guides/gta-5-100-completion-guide-checklist

items.title: The GTA 6 Trailer Song Nobody Expected 😮
items.description:
The GTA 6 trailer song? In trailer 1 it was Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road", a 1989 track from Full Moon Fever that was never released as a single, just a B-side. After the trailer came out in December 2023, Spotify told BBC Newsbeat that streams of the track rose 36,979% compared to the same time the week before. items.description:
Lindsay Lohan sued GTA 5. Did she win?

In 2014 she sued Take-Two and Rockstar Games in New York, saying the GTA 5 character Lacey Jonas, an "actress slash singer" hiding from paparazzi, was her look-alike. Her weapon was a New York privacy law from 1903: use someone's name, portrait or picture to sell something without written consent, and they can sue.

In 2018, New York's top court, the Court of Appeals, ruled 6-0 against her (one judge took no part). It called Lacey "a generic artistic depiction of a 'twenty something' woman" who is not recognizable as Lohan, so the case stayed dismissed.

The twist: the same ruling says a video-game avatar can count as a person's "portrait" under that law. In New York, if a game character is recognizably you, the 1903 law can apply.

Fair ruling? Yes or no?

Sources:
- Lohan v Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., 2018 NY Slip Op 02208, NY Court of Appeals, decided March 29, 2018 (opinion text, re-checked Nov 18, 2026): http://www.nycourts.gov/reporter/3dseries/2018/2018_02208.htm
- Printed copy of the opinion: https://rightofpublicityroadmap.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/lohan_v_take-two_interactive_software_inc.pdf
- AP, Lohan sues over Grand Theft Auto V game (July 2014): https://6abc.com/post/lohan-sues-over-grand-theft-auto-v-game/151607/

This is a summary of the court record, not legal advice. The court did not decide whether games are protected speech.

items.title: GTA 6 Got 99 on Metacritic. Only One Other Game Has That 🤯
items.description:
GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic. That ties the highest score on Metacritic's all-time game list.

Only one other game sits at 99: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, from 1998, on the Nintendo 64. Its 99 comes from 22 critic reviews. GTA 6's 99 comes from about 150 (the PS5 page counts 150 to 156 critic reviews; the Xbox Series X version is also 99, from 14).

And Metacritic's all-time top seven holds three GTA games: GTA 6 at 99 (1st), GTA 4 at 98 (5th) and GTA 5 at 97 (7th).

Does GTA 6 deserve the 99? Yes or no?

items.title: GTA 6 Had 7.9 Million Live Viewers at Once 🤯
items.description:
GTA 6 hit 7.9 million live viewers at the same time when it launched. That is the peak of concurrent viewers across livestream platforms on launch day, measured by Streams Charts (7,915,475).

The old game-launch record was Valorant's closed beta in April 2020, at about 1.74 million. GTA 6 is more than four and a half times that.

Twitch alone peaked at 3.31 million viewers for GTA 6, the most of any game ever on Twitch by peak viewers (ahead of League of Legends at 3.11 million). That is a record among games, not every Twitch category.

Viewers are not buyers: these are stream viewers at one moment, not sales or players.

Did you watch a stream, or play it yourself?

Numbers as Streams Charts showed them on November 20, 2026. Streams Charts calls launch data preliminary, so it can change. Platform peaks happened at different times and don't add up to the total.

items.title: GTA 6 Cops Remember 4 Things About You 🚔
items.description:
GTA 6's wanted level isn't just stars. Under them, icons show what the cops know about you, and in Rockstar's own getaway chase four are lit: that there are two of you, your clothes, what you look like, and your car. With a mask on in that shot, the description icon is still lit. To shake them: break their line of sight and the stars flash (GameSpot: flashing means they lost sight of you), then they turn red (near the scene, but the police don't know where you are). Then leave the car. The car icon disappears the moment Lucia steps out, and she burns it. The cops still remember the other three. There are also weapon and CCTV icons, not lit in this chase.

How to lose the cops in GTA 6, read straight off the real HUD.

items.title: GTA 6: Do These 4 Things Before You Get Busted 🚨
items.description:
Getting busted in GTA 6 costs you more than a respawn. Guides say the cops take your pocket cash, guns you looted, stolen cars and the stash bags you were carrying. Four things to do first:

1. Buy the gun you love: guns you loot are lost when you're busted; bought ones wait in an Ammu-Nation weapon locker (most stores) or your personal vehicle's trunk. Gold-icon Unique Weapon Variants stay unlocked once found.
2. Register your ride at a Pay 'n' Spray (for a fee): stolen cars are gone after an arrest. Get busted in your own car and it's impounded; getting it back through ScooterBros costs "a significant fee" (GamesRadar+).
3. Get stash bags to a fence first.
4. Bank your cash at an ATM or in BuckMe (unlocks in the Chapter 1 mission "Buck Me"). Each character can carry up to $20,000, and Game Rant and GamesRadar+ say all of it goes when you're busted (PC Gamer reports a smaller penalty of a few hundred dollars). The bank is safer, not free: small fees apply from Chapter 2.

items.title: GTA 5 vs GTA 6: Every Trailer, Side by Side
items.description:
GTA 5 vs GTA 6, every official trailer side by side: the first trailers, the heroes, the map, the gameplay reveal, the last trailer, and launch day. Thirteen years apart, the two first trailers open the same way, and both missed their first release date. The scoreboard did not match.

Both first trailers hit the same four opening beats in the same order. GTA 5 split its story between Michael, Franklin and Trevor; GTA 6 tells one story about Jason and Lucia. Both games missed their first release date. GTA 5 sold more than 800 million dollars on day one. GTA 6 sold 3.79 billion (Take-Two estimates).

Which first trailer wins, 2011 or 2023?
